records.evidence_group: edible fungi species, processing and canning
records.identity_and_source_boundary: Frozen fungi do not necessarily comprise mushrooms, nor canned mushrooms.
records.missing_affirmative_proof: Confirm the species, freeze-processing state, marketed form and official article on fungi/mushroom toxic substances.

records.evidence_group: edible fungi species, processing and canning
records.identity_and_source_boundary: Dried edible fungi may be non-mushroom species and are not canned.
records.missing_affirmative_proof: Record actual species and moisture basis; prove whether the mushroom toxic-substances article covers this dried preparation.

records.evidence_group: edible fungi species, processing and canning
records.identity_and_source_boundary: Grinding fungi does not turn every edible fungus into an exact mushroom food article.
records.missing_affirmative_proof: Provide species identity, ingredient source, particle/solids profile and exact dried-product contaminant matrix.

records.evidence_group: edible fungi species, processing and canning
records.identity_and_source_boundary: Extracted or concentrated fungal material is not automatically whole mushroom food.
records.missing_affirmative_proof: Verify botanical species, extraction process, concentration and whether the CTR mushroom article governs extracts.

records.evidence_group: edible fungi species, processing and canning
records.identity_and_source_boundary: Fungal concentrate powder differs from intact mushrooms and canned mushroom products.
records.missing_affirmative_proof: Prove species, concentrate processing, solids and the appropriate sample basis.

records.product_name: Fungi in olive oil and other vegetable oils
records.evidence_group: edible fungi species, processing and canning
records.identity_and_source_boundary: Packing fungi in oil does not prove the product is a hermetically canned mushroom article.
records.missing_affirmative_proof: Confirm mushroom species, packaging, heat processing, oil phase and finished container.

records.evidence_group: edible fungi species, processing and canning
records.identity_and_source_boundary: Salted fungi are semi-processed, not necessarily canned mushrooms.
records.missing_affirmative_proof: Prove species, salt ratio, finished consumption form and legal edible-fungi toxicological article.

records.evidence_group: edible fungi species, processing and canning
records.identity_and_source_boundary: Sterilization alone is not a regulatory synonym for canned mushrooms.
records.missing_affirmative_proof: Provide the fungal species, can/hermetic status, commercial sterility and named metal-article basis.

records.evidence_group: edible fungi species, processing and canning
records.identity_and_source_boundary: Pickling fungi does not make it an exact canned mushroom or cucumber pickle article.
records.missing_affirmative_proof: Record mushroom inclusion, brine/acid type, processing and finished packaging.

records.evidence_group: edible fungi species, processing and canning
records.identity_and_source_boundary: Fermentation can materially change the matrix, and fungi need not be mushrooms.
records.missing_affirmative_proof: Prove species, fermentation status and the specific FSSAI toxic substance reference applicable to the fermented food.

records.identity_and_source_boundary: Icing sugar 2.8.1(6) does not by name prove refined white sugar with CTR sulphated ash at most 0.03%.
records.missing_affirmative_proof: Determine starch or anti-caking component and actual sulphated-ash laboratory result before exact sugar-article adjudication.
candidate_reference_keys_not_applied: All types of sugars, sugar syrup, invert sugar and direct consumption coloured sugars with sulphated ash content exceeding 1.0 percent

records.identity_and_source_boundary: Khandsari 2.8.1(3) is separately classified; a refined sugar article cannot be presumed.
records.missing_affirmative_proof: Identify khandsari subtype and sulphated-ash content and the current named CTR article.
candidate_reference_keys_not_applied: All types of sugars, sugar syrup, invert sugar and direct consumption coloured sugars with sulphated ash content exceeding 1.0 percent

records.identity_and_source_boundary: Bura sugar 2.8.1(4) is its own standard, not a refined-sugar synonym.
records.missing_affirmative_proof: Establish chemical sugar form and the appropriate sulphated-ash threshold assay.
candidate_reference_keys_not_applied: All types of sugars, sugar syrup, invert sugar and direct consumption coloured sugars with sulphated ash content exceeding 1.0 percent

records.identity_and_source_boundary: Dried glucose syrup 2.8.7 requires sulphated ash not exceeding 1%; a CTR >1% ash article is excluded for conforming product.
records.missing_affirmative_proof: Separately confirm the correct legal lead article, not a blanket lead exemption; inspect composition and actual sulphated ash.
candidate_reference_keys_not_applied: All types of sugars, sugar syrup, invert sugar and direct consumption coloured sugars with sulphated ash content exceeding 1.0 percent

records.identity_and_source_boundary: Edible lactose 2.1.20 is dairy-derived sugar, not directly the animal 'Milks' CTR article.
records.missing_affirmative_proof: Find a named lactose-specific or other legally applicable contaminant source for the finished sugar.

records.identity_and_source_boundary: Plantation white sugar 2.8.1(1) is separately named from refined sugar 2.8.1(2).
records.missing_affirmative_proof: Obtain finished sugar characteristics and sulphated-ash chemical assay before use of either high-ash or refined sugar reference.
candidate_reference_keys_not_applied: All types of sugars, sugar syrup, invert sugar and direct consumption coloured sugars with sulphated ash content exceeding 1.0 percent

records.identity_and_source_boundary: Cube sugar 2.8.1(5) TOTAL ash criterion and CTR refined sugar SULPHATED ash criterion are not the same test.
records.missing_affirmative_proof: Prove source refined-white-sugar identity and sulphated-ash test, rather than converting total ash automatically.
candidate_reference_keys_not_applied: All types of sugars, sugar syrup, invert sugar and direct consumption coloured sugars with sulphated ash content exceeding 1.0 percent

records.identity_and_source_boundary: Misri under 2.8.2 is rock candy sugar, not automatically refined sugar for metal-source matching.
records.missing_affirmative_proof: Determine specific marketed form and verified sulphated-ash basis.
candidate_reference_keys_not_applied: All types of sugars, sugar syrup, invert sugar and direct consumption coloured sugars with sulphated ash content exceeding 1.0 percent

records.identity_and_source_boundary: Golden syrup 2.8.6 is a sugar syrup, but the CTR high-ash sugar/syrup article requires sulphated ash >1%.
records.missing_affirmative_proof: Measure sulphated ash and verify the exact product class before assignment.
candidate_reference_keys_not_applied: All types of sugars, sugar syrup, invert sugar and direct consumption coloured sugars with sulphated ash content exceeding 1.0 percent

records.identity_and_source_boundary: Liquid processed eggs are distinguishable from raw shell-free eggs for pesticide MRL test basis.
records.missing_affirmative_proof: Document whether whole egg, albumen or yolk, pasteurization and applicable legal residue processing-factor basis.

records.identity_and_source_boundary: Frozen egg requires whole/yolk/white subtype verification before using an 'Eggs' residue row.
records.missing_affirmative_proof: Confirm product matrix and published shell-free analytical interpretation after freezing.

records.identity_and_source_boundary: Dry egg powder has concentration effects versus shell-free liquid egg pesticide levels.
records.missing_affirmative_proof: Require a legal reconstitution or processing factor, egg fraction and analytical dry matter basis.

records.identity_and_source_boundary: Pickled eggs are a marinated/brined matrix not the same as raw shell-free eggs.
records.missing_affirmative_proof: Show drained versus as-sold basis, brine addition, permitted treatment and residue law.

records.identity_and_source_boundary: Version IX cereal-grain lead/cadmium source article expressly excludes quinoa.
records.missing_affirmative_proof: Find affirmative quinoa commodity-specific heavy-metal or pesticide article without general cereal transfer.

records.identity_and_source_boundary: Chia seeds are not automatically included in named oilseed aflatoxin/pesticide articles.
records.missing_affirmative_proof: Prove statutory commodity identity and applicable explicit edible seed article.

records.identity_and_source_boundary: Custard powder 2.4.9 can be maize- or tapioca/sago-based, not universally a cereal.
records.missing_affirmative_proof: Identify real starch ingredient, source plant and whether any processing-specific cereal/HCN article applies.

records.identity_and_source_boundary: Pasta 2.4.10 may use alternative flours; a wheat-only pesticide MRL cannot be inherited universally.
records.missing_affirmative_proof: Prove flour species, proportion and exact finished-pasta MRL legal article.

records.identity_and_source_boundary: Instant noodle allows cereal/tuber choices and fried or nonfried processing; raw grain MRL is not a complete noodle panel.
records.missing_affirmative_proof: Confirm formula, fried/nonfried method and legally supported finished-matrix residue treatment.

records.identity_and_source_boundary: Papad under 2.4.40 permits ingredient alternatives; no universal milled-grain pesticide article.
records.missing_affirmative_proof: Resolve pulse, grain, tuber and composite formulation before exact article matching.

records.identity_and_source_boundary: FoSCoS second Papad route points to 2.4.40, but is not proof of wheat or any one pesticide commodity.
records.missing_affirmative_proof: Reconcile identical papad standard across two FoSCoS routes and actual batch formula.

records.identity_and_source_boundary: Biscuit finished-product ash/acidity criteria are not direct pesticide MRLs for cereal ingredients.
records.missing_affirmative_proof: Identify flours and test official processed composite-food application separately.

records.identity_and_source_boundary: Wafer biscuits with layers and optional cream fillings differ from milled cereal commodity.
records.missing_affirmative_proof: Verify cereal ingredients, fillings and finished sampled matrix before product-specific MRL.

records.identity_and_source_boundary: CTR names chicory and coffee articles but a finished coffee/chicory mixture needs its own legal matrix determination.
records.missing_affirmative_proof: Establish roast/extraction state, chicory percentage and the named blend contaminant article.

records.identity_and_source_boundary: Version IX Lead article 'Cocoa powder' on dry fat-free basis is not the cocoa-bean article.
records.missing_affirmative_proof: Identify bean-specific source or legally supported transformation factor; no direct 5 mg/kg Lead inheritance.

records.product_name: Dry Mixtures of Cocoa and Sugars
records.identity_and_source_boundary: Mixed cocoa/sugar products cannot adopt either a pure cocoa powder or pure sugar metal article by name alone.
records.missing_affirmative_proof: Confirm dry recipe percentages, finished product identity and applicable mixed-product provision.

records.product_name: Cocoa mass or Cocoa/Chocolate Liquor and Cocoa Cake
records.identity_and_source_boundary: Cocoa mass/liquor/cake have retained fat and processing distinctions from cocoa powder.
records.missing_affirmative_proof: Verify actual cocoa derivative and any legally prescribed conversion to a dry fat-free analytical basis.

records.identity_and_source_boundary: Coconut 'milk' 2.3.51 is plant-origin, not the animal-milk article in Version IX.
records.missing_affirmative_proof: Find a source explicitly applicable to coconut extract finished-food metals.

records.identity_and_source_boundary: Coconut cream 2.3.52 is processed coconut, not bovine/buffalo cream.
records.missing_affirmative_proof: Prove coconut plant-food exact article and concentrated-matrix basis.

records.identity_and_source_boundary: Coconut milk powder 2.3.63 must not inherit skim milk powder Aflatoxin M1.
records.missing_affirmative_proof: Find an exact dry coconut ingredient or plant-derived product contaminant rule.

records.product_name: Drinking Water (Purified) sold through vending machine
records.identity_and_source_boundary: Water vended under FSSR 2.10.9 is not necessarily packaged drinking water under 2.10.8.
records.missing_affirmative_proof: Document packaged-versus-dispensed market form, official purity standard and sampling basis.

records.identity_and_source_boundary: Version IX Nickel article for hydrogenated/partly hydrogenated/interesterified fats demands positive process proof.
records.missing_affirmative_proof: Verify edible fat-spread subtype, process flow, fat phase hydrogenation/interesterification and minarine identity.

records.identity_and_source_boundary: FSSR 2.9.31 SEASONING 'may contain' herbs/spices but does not mandate them.
records.missing_affirmative_proof: Determine actual ingredient mix, dehydration basis and exactly which named spices/mix-masala metal article governs.

records.identity_and_source_boundary: Vegetable proteins 2.3.59 can derive from different plants, not always cereal/pulse/oilseed.
records.missing_affirmative_proof: Prove actual species, isolate/concentrate processing and composite aflatoxin applicability.

records.identity_and_source_boundary: FoSCoS L(+/-) tartaric acid label is ambiguous against exact L(+) tartaric acid metal article.
records.missing_affirmative_proof: Confirm INS 334, CAS 87-69-4 and stereoisomer identity, then consider lead/arsenic purity independently.

records.identity_and_source_boundary: Pan masala 2.11.5 MAY contain betelnut, so its name does not prove arecanut exists.
records.missing_affirmative_proof: Show approved formula and actual arecanut inclusion to assess named composite aflatoxin product article.

records.identity_and_source_boundary: Colouring foods are not automatically standardized synthetic food colours or pigments.
records.missing_affirmative_proof: Prove food colouring source/material and respective colour additive legal identity.

records.identity_and_source_boundary: FoSCoS Category 18 Indian confections does not establish the finished identity 'Hard boiled sugar confectionery'.
records.missing_affirmative_proof: Show the exact cooking, sugar matrix and solid hard-boiled finished form before considering four CTR metal rows.

records.identity_and_source_boundary: A thermally processed fruit mix is not necessarily the canned fruit cocktail/salad form named in Version IX.
records.missing_affirmative_proof: Prove actual fruit composition and airtight canned product and its metal testing basis.

records.identity_and_source_boundary: Fruit cheese is a concentrated cooked product, not automatically canned fruit pulp.
records.missing_affirmative_proof: Verify whether its composition and final matrix legally qualify for the named pulp-products article.

records.identity_and_source_boundary: Generic fruit-and-vegetable chutney does not automatically constitute specifically named Mango Chutney.
records.missing_affirmative_proof: Prove the particular finished Mango Chutney identity and packaging to apply that row.

records.identity_and_source_boundary: Fruit bar/toffee is processed and not automatically identical to the raw fruit pulp article.
records.missing_affirmative_proof: Identify the exact cooked fruit pulp finished-article basis, whether confection or pulp.

records.identity_and_source_boundary: Date paste is a prepared fruit product, not directly a whole fruit or canned fruit.
records.missing_affirmative_proof: Prove processed fruit-pulp article application and dried/as-sold analytical basis.

records.identity_and_source_boundary: Ayurveda Aahara standard recipe 14.3 is a mixed food, not automatically animal milk in Version IX.
records.missing_affirmative_proof: Check positive mandatory listed rice/pulse/oilseed/nut ingredient and actual recipe against a named composite aflatoxin article.

records.identity_and_source_boundary: Ayurveda Aahara recipe 14.7 is a mixed preparation, not simply 'Milks' metal article.
records.missing_affirmative_proof: Prove positively listed qualifying cereal/pulse/oilseed/nut and actual formula to select a composite contaminant article.

records.product_name: Thermally Processed Concentrated Vegetable Juice Pulp/ Puree
records.identity_and_source_boundary: General vegetable concentrated pulp does not necessarily contain tomato.
records.missing_affirmative_proof: Prove tomato puree/paste/concentrate identity and copper dried tomato solids analytical basis.

records.product_name: Vegetable Pulp/Puree with Preservatives for Industrial Use only
records.identity_and_source_boundary: Vegetable pulp intended for industry is not automatically tomato puree/paste.
records.missing_affirmative_proof: Require actual tomato species, processing and preserved finished form before copper reference.

records.product_name: Concentrated Vegetable Pulp/Puree with Preservatives for industrial use only
records.identity_and_source_boundary: Concentrated preserved vegetable pulp may be non-tomato; lead/tin processed tomato article is conditional.
records.missing_affirmative_proof: Confirm tomato concentrate exact subtype and copper dried tomato solids basis, packaged metal basis.
